Subject: Delayed PO — request for short eval extension

We're in the final steps with procurement but Legal pushed the PO review into next week, so the purchase order won't be issued before our scheduled deep-dive next Tuesday. The engineering team is halfway through an integration test and we'd like to keep our evaluation active — otherwise the work stops and momentum is lost.

Can Redwood temporarily extend our evaluation window or grant a short pack of credits so we can complete the integration while the PO is processed? We expect the PO to clear within 10–14 days; vendor contact is procurement@vegahealth.com.

I've attached a draft PO for context (PO_draft_Vega_20260809.pdf). Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,

Hi Mark,

Thanks for the note and the PO draft — appreciate the context. We can support you while procurement finishes review. Two practical options:

- Immediate: grant a one-off promotional credit so your engineers can continue testing (I can request an approval for this).
- Alternate: extend the evaluation window by 30 days and keep the current seats active until the PO clears.

To move quickly I copied Aditya (Account Exec) and Priyom (Sales Ops) to confirm approvals and the promo cap. If you prefer, we can split the difference — a 30-day extension plus a modest credit to cover burst usage.

Would you be okay with our granting a temporary promo credit (we normally keep these under $2k list-equivalent, but we can request an exception for enterprise deals)? Also please confirm the expected PO send date so I can note it in our system.

Next steps:
- Mark: confirm expected PO send date (or escalation contact).
- Aditya / Priyom: can you advise on promo ceiling and any approval cadence I should follow?

Best,
Laura Bennett

Ask: can we approve a one-off promotional credit to bridge the evaluation so the integration doesn't stall? Suggested amount: 15k token-equivalent (covers the next two weeks of heavy tests). If that's too high, request a floor of 10k with an extension of 30 days.

Rationale:
- High probability of conversion once Legal clears PO (large ARR).
- Keeps technical momentum; customer already integrated initial hooks.
- PO draft attached for reference.

Please advise if you need me to log an approval ticket or route for finance sign-off.
